build_KmeansAttention: build a KmeansAttention module with configurable clusters, window size, and causal masking for efficient attention
build_SelfAttention: build a SelfAttention module combining local and kmeans global attention with rotary positional embeddings
build_Kmeans: build a Kmeans clustering module with EMA updates and commitment loss for vector quantization
build_FeedForward: build a FeedForward module with GELU activation and optional GLU gating for transformer layers
build_FixedPositionalEmbedding: build a FixedPositionalEmbedding module that generates sinusoidal positional embeddings for a given max sequence length
